title: Per-target claim matrix: every claim bound to a target, profile, artefact and TCB

candidate.note: The matrix describes evidence that already exists on this tree. It does not rebuild any artefact and does not move any recorded result to a new target.

binding_fields: build profile and the flags that matter (opt-level, overflow checks, LTO, codegen units, target features)
exact artefact sha256 and build id where recorded
source identity of the artefact's build, or UNKNOWN with an explanation
the instrument that bears on the claim, or NONE
the TCB digest of the live toolchain, with the basis on which a historical build is said to match it

refusal_rules.name: no inheritance across targets or profiles
artefact digest and build id must match the recorded build
TCB must match the recorded TCB for that build
source identity must match the artefact's build or carry an explanation
no status vocabulary that asserts a source-to-binary correspondence
